labels.name: bonsai.allows
labels.description: Protected paths this task may change, as globs. A path on the person-only list counts only if a person granted it.

labels.name: bonsai.wants
labels.description: Person-only paths this task asks for. A person's approval or grant copies them into bonsai.allows.

labels.name: bonsai.ladder
labels.description: The rungs this task climbs. It adds rungs to the workspace's floor and never drops one.

labels.name: bonsai.branch
labels.description: The branch the task is built on; empty means the base branch.

lanes.name: light
lanes.description: Bug fixes, tweaks, refactors, tests and docs: under about 200 changed lines, no new wire or data format, nothing a player notices. Build it, climb the ladder, land it.

lanes.name: full
lanes.description: A feature: anything a player notices, or a change to a wire format, a data schema or a public contract. A person approves the one-pager and the plan before code, and closes the task.

lanes.name: director
lanes.description: A decision, not code: design and feel, scope, an irreversible technical choice, or whether it is good. Write the options and stop; a person chooses.

labels.name: workflow.owner
labels.description: The role that owns the task's work.

labels.name: workflow.model
labels.description: The Claude Code model the work runs on, or ran on (Claude Code only).

labels.name: workflow.feature
labels.description: The one-pager (kind feature) this belongs to, by its id.

labels.name: workflow.milestone
labels.description: The milestone this counts toward, by the project's own name for it.

labels.name: workflow.spec
labels.description: The spec (kind spec) this task carries out, by its id.

labels.name: workflow.estimate_h
labels.description: The task's estimate in hours, written with the task.
